title: Pakistan Army Medical Cadet 2026: Eligibility, Dates & MDCAT
metaDescription: Join Pakistan Army as Medical Cadet 2026: 51st MBBS and 29th BDS entry at AMC Rawalpindi. Check age 17-21, 70% FSc marks, NUMS MDCAT rules and key dates.
headline: Pakistan Army Medical Cadet 2026: Complete Selection Guide

sections.content:
The Pakistan Army has opened online registration for the 51st MBBS and 29th BDS Medical Cadet Entry 2026 at Army Medical College (AMC) Rawalpindi, an institution affiliated with the National University of Medical Sciences (NUMS). The MBBS program runs for five years and the BDS program for four years, combining a full medical education with military training and discipline.

Selected cadets study at AMC Rawalpindi and, upon successful completion of their degree and basic military training, are granted commission in the Pakistan Army as Captain in the Army Medical Corps. The program offers a fully structured career with salary, benefits, and long-term job security.
sections.title: 51st MBBS and 29th BDS Entry: What the Program Offers

sections.content:
Only male, unmarried candidates who are citizens of Pakistan or domicile holders of Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan may apply. Candidates must be between 17 and 21 years of age as of 1st November 2026, and no age relaxation is admissible beyond the standard three-month margin on either side.

Academically, applicants need FSc Pre-Medical with a minimum of 70 percent marks. Candidates from Balochistan, Tharparkar, Umerkot, northern areas, upper Neelum Valley and former FATA regions may apply with 65 percent. A-Level candidates must have passed Biology, Physics and Chemistry with at least grade C, along with an IBCC equivalence certificate.
sections.title: Eligibility Criteria: Age, Gender and Education

sections.content:
Appearing in the NUMS MDCAT 2026 is strictly mandatory for every applicant, and candidates who skip it are not considered regardless of their FSc marks. After the MDCAT result is announced, candidates must enter their marks online on the Join Pakistan Army portal within one week, since the registration website opens for mark uploading for a limited window only.

Candidates who have passed FSc Part-I with 70 percent and are appearing in Part-II may apply on a Hope Certificate issued by their institution head. They must submit an attested copy of their FSc Part-II certificate to the PA Directorate at GHQ Rawalpindi within five days of the result announcement, otherwise their selection is not processed further.
sections.title: NUMS MDCAT: The Mandatory Entrance Test

sections.content:
Applications are submitted online through the official Join Pakistan Army portal at joinpakarmy.gov.pk by selecting the Medical Cadet Entry 2026 section. Candidates fill in personal and academic details carefully, submit the form before the deadline, and then upload their NUMS MDCAT marks within the specified window after results.

For Entry 2026, online registration ran from 15 June to 14 July 2026. Candidates can also visit Army Selection and Recruitment Centres in Rawalpindi, Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar, Quetta, Gilgit, Hyderabad, Multan, D.I. Khan, Muzaffarabad, Faisalabad, Khuzdar and Pano Aqil for guidance.
